_doc: Local withhold list for Empathy Ledger editorial content, enforced by scripts/sync-el-editorial.mjs on every build, including when Empathy Ledger is unreachable and the previous snapshot is kept. Anything in `slugs`, or attributed to a storyteller id in `storytellerIds`, is withheld from the site. The sync reads ONLY those two arrays; every key beginning with an underscore is documentation.
_twoKindsOfEntry: This file holds two different decisions and they are not interchangeable. Read `_editorialWithdrawals` and `_consentRevocations` before removing anything. Membership here is NOT evidence that a community withdrew consent, and treating it that way would misrepresent an editorial call as a community one.
_editorialWithdrawals: ACT decided not to publish these. Empathy Ledger still offers them: as at 2026-08-15 all five were `published` and `syndication_enabled` for act_el in the authenticated feed. They are off the site ONLY because they are listed here, so this file is the sole record of the decision. Removing an entry republishes that article on the next deploy. The five: the-act-comic, edition-1-sowing-seeds-of-connection-2, from-bolivia-to-brisbane, powering-change-a-curious-tractors-journey, spain-diagrama-trip-reflection. A sixth, the-power-of-indigenous-storytelling-a-community-perspective, was also an editorial decision (Ben's call, 2026-08-09, recorded on an article_reviews row rather than in syndication_audit_log precisely so it was not filed as a consent withdrawal) and is additionally unpublished upstream.
_consentRevocations: Different in kind. The syndication_consent row for this site was revoked in Empathy Ledger on 2026-07-29 for these three: a-heros-journey-from-addiction-to-inspiration-the-life-of-vireak, a-story-of-resilience-and-advocacy, nhats-story-finding-belonging-and-purpose-at-the-hope-centre. Empathy Ledger now excludes them upstream, so listing them is redundant while it is reachable and load-bearing when it is not. That is the whole point of the file. They are personal addiction and recovery stories, which is the last category that should depend on a fetch succeeding.
_doNotRetire: On 2026-08-15 it was suggested this file could come down now that an Empathy Ledger feed fault is fixed. It cannot. The fault and this file are unrelated: the fault was a bug, this is a record of decisions Empathy Ledger does not hold. Five entries are actively suppressing content the feed offers today. The fault also does not reproduce but was never explained, so the local signal stays until it is.
